report_type: Minecraft Desktop E2E Test Suite Execution Report

tier1.name: Tier 1: Functional Features
tier1.description: Core physics kinematics, DDA raycast, 41-slot inventory, crafting, audio formulas, base-path resolver

tests.name: test_01_ui_click_duration_and_waveform
tests.description: Verify UI Click: 15ms duration (661 samples at 44.1kHz), square wave bounds [-1.0, 1.0], linear decay.

tests.name: test_02_footstep_noise_and_exponential_thump
tests.description: Verify Footstep: 40ms duration (1764 samples), combined noise and 80Hz thump with rapid exponential decay.

tests.name: test_03_jump_frequency_sweep_and_adsr_envelope
tests.description: Verify Jump: 90ms duration (3969 samples), 25% duty square wave, linear attack (5ms) and decay (85ms).

tests.name: test_04_block_break_crunch_shatter_envelope
tests.description: Verify Block Break: 160ms duration (7056 samples), LFSR noise + subharmonic decay.

tests.name: test_05_block_place_pitch_plummet_thud
tests.description: Verify Block Place: 50ms duration (2205 samples), triangle wave with pitch plummet 220*2^(-25t).

tests.name: test_01_strip_executable_name_to_directory
tests.description: Verify stripping executable binary name yields clean parent directory.

tests.name: test_02_saves_directory_strict_adjacency
tests.description: Verify save files are stored strictly adjacent to binary in ./saves/.

tests.name: test_03_paths_with_spaces_and_special_characters
tests.description: Verify paths containing spaces, accents, or symbols resolve without corruption.

tests.name: test_04_read_only_media_fallback
tests.description: Verify read-only base path activates graceful fallback to temporary directory.

tests.name: test_05_cwd_independence_invariant
tests.description: Verify game resolves base path from executable location, NOT from current working directory.

tests.name: test_01_shapeless_log_to_planks
tests.description: Verify 1 Wood Log in any slot of 2x2 grid crafts 4 Wood Planks.

tests.name: test_02_shaped_sticks_translation_invariance
tests.description: Verify 2 vertical planks craft 4 sticks regardless of column offset in 2x2 or 3x3.

tests.name: test_03_crafting_table_2x2_and_furnace_3x3
tests.description: Verify 4 planks -> 1 Crafting Table (2x2) and 8 cobblestone ring -> 1 Furnace (3x3).

tests.name: test_04_tools_recipes_pickaxes_durability
tests.description: Verify wooden, stone, and iron pickaxe recipes with canonical durability (59, 131, 250).

tests.name: test_05_craft_action_ingredient_consumption
tests.description: Verify executing craft() decrements each ingredient by exactly 1 and clears exhausted slots.

tests.name: test_06_invalid_recipes_return_none
tests.description: Verify non-matching or distorted patterns reject crafting.

tests.name: test_01_exact_single_physics_tick
tests.description: Verify elapsed time equal to fixed dt (1/60s) triggers exactly 1 physics tick and alpha=0.0.

tests.name: test_02_sub_frame_accumulator_and_render_alpha
tests.description: Verify frame time shorter than dt (e.g. 120 FPS, dt/2) produces 0 ticks and alpha=0.5.

tests.name: test_03_spiral_of_death_clamp
tests.description: Verify massive lag spike or pause (e.g. 2.0s) clamps to MAX_FRAME_TIME (0.25s).

tests.name: test_04_render_interpolation_alpha_bounds
tests.description: Verify alpha remains strictly within interval [0.0, 1.0) under arbitrary frame timings.

tests.name: test_05_smooth_position_lerp
tests.description: Verify render position interpolates smoothly between previous and current physics ticks.

tests.name: test_01_contiguous_41_slot_layout
tests.description: Verify 41-slot layout: 9 hotbar + 27 main + 4 armor + 1 offhand.

tests.name: test_02_hotbar_selection_and_scroll_wrap
tests.description: Verify 9-slot selection maps keys 1-9 and mouse scroll with modulo wrap.

tests.name: test_03_stack_size_hierarchy
tests.description: Verify canonical stack limits: 64 (blocks), 16 (compact), 1 (tools).

tests.name: test_04_mouse_click_pickup_place_swap
tests.description: Verify left click pickups, places into empty slot, and swaps mismatched items.

tests.name: test_05_mouse_right_click_single_place_and_split
tests.description: Verify right click places 1 item from cursor or picks up half from slot.

tests.name: test_06_shift_click_quick_move
tests.description: Verify shift-click moves item instantly between hotbar (0-8) and main storage (9-35).

tests.name: test_01_standing_and_sneaking_aabb_dimensions
tests.description: Verify rigid AABB dimensions: Standing 0.6x1.8x0.6m, Sneaking 0.6x1.5x0.6m.

tests.name: test_02_standing_and_sneaking_eye_level_offsets
tests.description: Verify camera eye level offsets: Standing 1.62m, Sneaking 1.35m.

tests.name: test_03_gravity_acceleration_and_terminal_velocity
tests.description: Verify downward acceleration g=-32.0 m/s^2 and terminal velocity ceiling v_term=-78.4 m/s.

tests.name: test_04_jump_impulse_and_apex_clearance
tests.description: Verify jump impulse v_jump=8.944 m/s clears >= 1.25m obstacle height.

tests.name: test_05_ground_friction_and_air_drag
tests.description: Verify ground deceleration is responsive while airborne momentum preserves ballistic flight.

tests.name: test_06_movement_speed_multipliers
tests.description: Verify base speeds: Walk 4.317 m/s, Sprint 5.612 m/s, Sneak 1.295 m/s.

tests.name: test_01_cardinal_raycast_face_normal_invariants
tests.description: Verify entered face normal is strictly the negative step direction across all 6 cardinal directions.

tests.name: test_02_reach_distance_thresholds
tests.description: Verify reach cutoff: hits within max_reach succeed; blocks beyond max_reach report miss.

tests.name: test_03_diagonal_3d_ray_traversal_order
tests.description: Verify diagonal 3D ray traverses every discrete lattice cell along the trajectory.

tests.name: test_04_collinear_axis_zero_components
tests.description: Verify raycast handles zero look components (e.g. dy=0, dz=0) without division-by-zero crashes.

tests.name: test_05_immediate_inside_solid_block
tests.description: Verify if eye origin is already inside a solid block, DDA detects hit at distance 0.

tier2.name: Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases
tier2.description: Negative coordinates, terminal velocity anti-tunneling, auto-step ceiling abort, sneak ledge-clamp, bedrock

tests.name: test_01_placement_at_player_feet_rejected
tests.description: Verify placing a block directly inside player's lower body is rejected.

tests.name: test_02_placement_at_player_head_rejected
tests.description: Verify placing a block at player eye level (y=65) is rejected while standing.

tests.name: test_03_placement_above_sneaking_player_accepted
tests.description: Verify placing block at y=66 above a sneaking player (height 1.5m -> top at 65.5m) is accepted.

tests.name: test_04_adjacent_placement_without_overlap_accepted
tests.description: Verify placing block immediately adjacent to player's bounding box is accepted.

tests.name: test_05_world_height_boundaries
tests.description: Verify placement at y < 0 or y >= 256 is strictly rejected.

tests.name: test_06_occupied_cell_rejection
tests.description: Verify placing into an already occupied block (not air) is rejected.

tests.name: test_01_step_up_success_with_clear_headroom
tests.description: Verify 0.5m slab step-up succeeds when vertical headspace (>= 1.8m) is completely clear.

tests.name: test_02_step_up_aborted_due_to_low_ceiling
tests.description: Verify 0.5m step-up is aborted if ceiling block is directly overhead (headroom < 1.8m).

tests.name: test_03_airborne_player_cannot_autostep
tests.description: Verify player in mid-air (is_grounded == False) cannot auto-step up walls.

tests.name: test_04_wall_too_high_for_autostep
tests.description: Verify full 1.0m tall wall cannot be auto-stepped with 0.55m step height.

tests.name: test_05_multi_step_staircase_climb
tests.description: Verify successive auto-steps allow ascending a multi-tier 0.5m staircase smoothly without jumping.

tests.name: test_01_bedrock_indestructible_under_extreme_tools
tests.description: Verify bedrock (H = -1.0) never breaks even with maximum tool multiplier over thousands of ticks.

tests.name: test_02_instant_break_zero_hardness
tests.description: Verify blocks with H = 0.0 (tall grass, flowers) shatter on the very first tick.

tests.name: test_03_crack_stages_clamp_to_zero_through_nine
tests.description: Verify crack stages progress monotonically through 0..9 and never exceed 9.

tests.name: test_04_retargeting_adjacent_block_resets_progress
tests.description: Verify shifting crosshair from block A to block B resets break progress to 0.

tests.name: test_05_player_moving_out_of_reach_resets_progress
tests.description: Verify player backing away beyond 5.0m maximum reach aborts breaking and resets progress.

tests.name: test_01_partial_stack_overflow_remainder
tests.description: Verify adding 30 items to a slot with 50 items (max 64) returns exactly 16 remainder.

tests.name: test_02_completely_full_inventory_zero_item_loss
tests.description: Verify adding items to completely filled inventory returns 100% of items without destruction.

tests.name: test_03_left_drag_even_distribution_with_cursor_remainder
tests.description: Verify left-drag distributes items equally across targeted slots and keeps remainder in cursor.

tests.name: test_04_right_drag_one_per_slot_distribution
tests.description: Verify right-drag places exactly 1 item per slot and decrements cursor count accordingly.

tests.name: test_05_unstackable_tools_strictly_forbidden_from_merging
tests.description: Verify tools with max_stack=1 never merge into counts > 1.

tests.name: test_01_boundary_around_zero
tests.description: Verify chunk and local coordinates across zero boundary: X=0 vs X=-1.

tests.name: test_02_negative_chunk_boundary_16_to_17
tests.description: Verify chunk transition from chunk -1 to chunk -2 at X=-16 and X=-17.

tests.name: test_03_deep_negative_coordinate_bitshifts
tests.description: Verify large negative coordinates map accurately to chunk and local coordinates.

tests.name: test_04_roundtrip_coordinate_reconstruction_invariant
tests.description: Verify roundtrip identity: WorldCoord == ChunkCoord * 16 + LocalCoord across [-5000, 5000].

tests.name: test_05_flat_chunk_voxel_index_bounds
tests.description: Verify 3D YZX index (ly + lx*256 + lz*4096) is strictly in [0, 65535] (64 KiB).

tests.name: test_01_sneak_prevents_walking_off_edge_x
tests.description: Verify sneaking player on isolated 1x1 block cannot fall off towards +X.

tests.name: test_02_sneak_prevents_walking_off_edge_z
tests.description: Verify sneaking player on isolated 1x1 block cannot fall off towards +Z.

tests.name: test_03_convex_corner_diagonal_clamping
tests.description: Verify diagonal movement into a convex corner clamps both axes safely at edge.

tests.name: test_04_sliding_along_edge_parallel_axis_unblocked
tests.description: Verify clamping along X (cliff edge) does not block movement along Z (supported pathway).

tests.name: test_05_releasing_sneak_allows_falling
tests.description: Verify releasing sneak (is_sneaking=False) allows player to walk off edge and fall.

tests.name: test_01_terminal_velocity_single_block_floor_landing
tests.description: Verify falling at terminal velocity (-78.4 m/s) does not tunnel through a 1-block thick floor.

tests.name: test_02_terminal_velocity_thin_slab_landing
tests.description: Verify falling at terminal velocity onto a 1-block tall boundary stops cleanly on upper boundary.

tests.name: test_03_high_speed_impact_preserves_horizontal_coordinates
tests.description: Verify vertical terminal velocity impact does not corrupt horizontal X/Z coordinates.

tests.name: test_04_continuous_fall_through_shaft_to_bottom
tests.description: Verify falling 100 blocks through a 1x1 empty vertical shaft terminates safely on bottom bedrock.

tests.name: test_05_ceiling_bump_during_rapid_upward_trajectory
tests.description: Verify high upward velocity hitting a ceiling stops at ceiling bottom without tunneling through.

tier3.name: Tier 3: Pairwise Interactions
tier3.description: Sprint-jumping + exhaustion, DDA mining + drops, crafting table lifecycle, auto-step + sneak cornering

tests.name: test_01_sneaking_player_autosteps_onto_slab
tests.description: Verify player in sneak mode automatically steps up +0.5m onto slab at (1, 64, 0).

tests.name: test_02_elevation_retention_while_sneaking
tests.description: Verify sneaking player maintains elevated y=64.5 while moving across slab (1, 64, 0) to (2, 64, 0).

tests.name: test_03_elevated_edge_clamp_prevents_falling_to_lower_floor
tests.description: Verify sneak ledge clamp prevents player from stepping off the elevated slab perimeter.

tests.name: test_04_sliding_along_elevated_l_shape
tests.description: Verify moving diagonally at edge clamps cliff axis while allowing progress down the L-track (+Z).

tests.name: test_05_releasing_sneak_on_elevated_platform_drops_player
tests.description: Verify releasing sneak on elevated platform allows walking off and falling back down.

tests.name: test_01_open_table_3x3_grid_initial_state
tests.description: Verify opening crafting table initializes empty 3x3 matrix.

tests.name: test_02_recipe_matching_furnace
tests.description: Verify populating 8 cobblestone around outer border detects Furnace in output slot.

tests.name: test_03_take_output_consumes_ingredients
tests.description: Verify taking crafted output decrements each ingredient slot by exactly 1.

tests.name: test_04_closing_table_returns_orphan_items_to_inventory
tests.description: Verify closing crafting table returns all remaining items in 3x3 grid to player inventory.

tests.name: test_05_overflow_drops_on_ground_when_inventory_full
tests.description: Verify if player inventory is full upon close, remaining items drop on ground without vanishing.

tests.name: test_01_dda_target_and_progressive_mining_lifecycle
tests.description: Verify DDA raycast locks onto Wood Log and bare-hand mining breaks it after 120 ticks (2.0s).

tests.name: test_02_block_break_spawns_3d_item_drop
tests.description: Verify block break spawns a 3D ItemDropEntity centered in the broken voxel.

tests.name: test_03_item_drop_collection_radius
tests.description: Verify item drop is collected when player enters 1.5m radius and adds to inventory.

tests.name: test_04_tool_mining_speedup_and_durability_decrement
tests.description: Verify wooden pickaxe (tool multiplier M=2.0) mines stone in 0.75s and loses 1 durability.

tests.name: test_05_reach_violation_cancels_mining
tests.description: Verify backing outside 5.0m reach envelope during mining cancels progress.

tests.name: test_01_sprint_speed_and_exhaustion_accumulation
tests.description: Verify sprinting applies sprint speed (5.612 m/s) and accumulates 0.1 exhaustion per meter.

tests.name: test_02_sprint_jump_compound_exhaustion
tests.description: Verify sprint-jump compounds both sprint exhaustion (0.1/m) and jump exhaustion (0.8/jump).

tests.name: test_03_saturation_exhaustion_drain_into_hunger
tests.description: Verify exhaustion drains saturation first; once saturation is 0, hunger food points drain.

tests.name: test_04_hunger_threshold_disables_sprinting
tests.description: Verify when hunger drops to <= 6.0, sprinting is disabled and speed reverts to walking.

tests.name: test_05_dynamic_fov_warping_and_decay
tests.description: Verify dynamic FOV expands to 1.15x on sprint, then decays to 1.0x when sprinting stops.

tier4.name: Tier 4: Real-World Workloads
tier4.description: First Day Survival 14-step progression, fatal fall death/respawn, 1200s celestial diurnal cycle

tests.name: test_01_zenith_noon_sun_elevation
tests.description: Verify noon at t=300s (phi = pi/2) puts sun near zenith (+Y).

tests.name: test_02_midnight_sun_nadir_and_night_darkness
tests.description: Verify midnight at t=900s (phi = 3pi/2) puts sun below horizon and daylight factor is 0.0.

tests.name: test_03_dawn_and_dusk_horizons
tests.description: Verify sunrise (t=0s, phi=0) and sunset (t=600s, phi=pi) align with horizon.

tests.name: test_04_directional_face_shading_factors
tests.description: Verify directional face occlusion constants: Top 1.00, Bottom 0.50, N/S 0.80, E/W 0.60.

tests.name: test_05_smooth_24h_cycle_continuity
tests.description: Verify sun trajectory and daylight factor vary continuously without discontinuities over 1200s.

tests.name: test_01_non_fatal_fall_damage_equation
tests.description: Verify non-fatal fall damage: ceil(d - 3.0). Fall from 6m deals exactly 3 damage.

tests.name: test_02_water_impact_damage_negation
tests.description: Verify falling 50m directly into water completely negates all fall damage.

tests.name: test_03_fatal_fall_damage_triggers_death
tests.description: Verify falling 25m deals 22 damage, reducing 20 HP to 0 and marking player dead.

tests.name: test_04_inventory_items_scatter_on_death
tests.description: Verify upon death, all carried inventory items drop at the death location.

tests.name: test_05_respawn_restores_health_hunger_and_clears_inventory
tests.description: Verify respawn restores HP to 20, Hunger to 20, is_alive to True, and resets position.
